improvement: Semantic follow-up rewrites now start at the latest substantive user topic, excluding obsolete questions, answers and citations while retaining intervening conversational turns and the latest complete answer or roster.
reproduced_before: After a clear change from a Mopti needs question to a Gao organisations question, the rewrite context still contained both topics and the obsolete Mopti answer and citation.

qualification.topic_boundary_guard: The most recent substantive user turn is derived from its stored standalone question when available, otherwise its content.
qualification.conversation_guard: Conversational and conversation-only turns do not replace the latest substantive topic boundary.
qualification.stale_context_guard: Assistant text and citations before the current topic boundary are excluded from semantic rewrite context.
qualification.evidence_guard: Retained assistant text is context only and never evidence; the rewritten question still proceeds through fresh research and citation generation.

deployment.blocker: Exact-SHA deployment to the authorised V4 test service requires a secure signed-in dashboard session. Generic deployment remains unsafe because the configured source branch is older and divergent.
deployment.next_action: Deploy published_code_commit to V4 test only, then live-test a substantive topic change followed by a pronoun follow-up, plus previous-week, next-week, current-week, prior year and month, explicit-range, mixed-roster, active-only, catalogue, empty-subset, selected-ID and geography regressions.

rollback.database: No schema or data change. Retain the existing additive evaluation schema and reviewed source facts.

continuity.do_not_repeat: Do not rebuild the accepted source publication or the qualified deterministic follow-up filters. Reconcile the latest candidate branch and service before exact-SHA deployment.
continuity.if_deployment_still_blocked: Continue the next bounded Q-006 stored-context boundary or pronoun-follow-up case after reproducing it.

preservation: Accepted PADEL publication, FONGIM selection, geography, source catalogue, response, dossier and account behavior retained; no database, source record, service configuration, access, production or administration change.
limitations: The deterministic topic boundary examines the latest ten stored messages supplied to the rewrite layer.
Semantic follow-up rewriting remains model-mediated after context selection.
No live acceptance, actual-database qualification or full model benchmark was performed.
spending: All qualification was local and made no external model or research calls.
